description: 为已有短链返回可扫描二维码。默认 PNG 512×512，并包含 image/png 图片块。仅当 format 为 svg 时返回 SVG，且不以 image 块返回。二维码中编码的是带有 ?s=qr 来源标记的短链接（使用 ASCII 域名），与 GET /v1/links/{id}/qr 返回的二维码内容一致。需要已注册账号，且必须是该链接的所有者。不新建短链，也不抓取目标地址。PNG 边长仅 256、512、1024，SVG 忽略边长。可能包含短期 image_url 及其到期时间；该链接不是 API 密钥、OAuth 令牌或会话。返回已存储短链的二维码：默认 PNG，请求时为 SVG；可用时附带短期 image_url。二维码编码的是 qr_tracking_url。未显示图片时，可使用 image_url（如有）或短链。 Return a scannable QR for an existing short link. Default PNG is 512×512 and includes an image/png image block. SVG is returned only when format is svg, and not as an image block. The matrix encodes the tracking URL with ?s=qr (ASCII host), the same payload as GET /v1/links/{id}/qr. A registered account that owns the link is required. Does not create a link and does not fetch the destination. PNG size is 256, 512, or 1024. SVG ignores size. A short-lived image_url and its expiry may be included. That URL is not an API key, an OAuth token, or a session. Returns the stored link's QR as PNG, or SVG when requested, with a short-lived image URL where available. The QR encodes qr_tracking_url. Where an image is not displayed, image_url (when present) or the short link reaches the same code.

format.description: Image format. Default png. svg only when requested. SVG ignores size.

id.description: Existing short code. Mutually exclusive with short_url.

short_url.description: Existing short URL to tag for QR. Mutually exclusive with id.

size.description: PNG square pixels. Default 512. Allowed: 256, 512, or 1024. Ignored when format is svg.

name: create_qr

host_display.description: Neutral summary of the returned QR: format, the encoded qr_tracking_url, and image_url availability.

image_available.description: True only when a PNG image block is included.

image_url.description: Short-lived URL for this QR image. Omitted when signing is not configured. Not an API key, OAuth token, or session.

image_url_expires_at.description: ISO-8601 expiry of image_url. Present only together with image_url.

mime_type.description: image/png. A PNG image block is included.

qr_tracking_url.description: ASCII tracking URL encoded in the image, including ?s=qr.

host_display.description: Neutral summary of the returned QR: format, the encoded qr_tracking_url, and image_url availability.

image_available.description: False for SVG. Hosts do not render an SVG image block. Use the SVG text, resource, or image_url.

image_url.description: Short-lived URL for this QR image. Omitted when signing is not configured. Not an API key, OAuth token, or session.

image_url_expires_at.description: ISO-8601 expiry of image_url. Present only together with image_url.

mime_type.description: image/svg+xml. SVG is not sent as an image block.

qr_tracking_url.description: ASCII tracking URL encoded in the image, including ?s=qr.
